entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'd like to start a return for an order I received about ten days ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I get your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Sam Jones, order number is VF551984.
Thank you, Sam. I see the order here for the RidgeLine Helmet. What specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's really just a preference. The color on the website looked like a deep blue, but in person it's much brighter than I wanted. The box is still unopened, it's in perfect condition.
I understand completely, sometimes colors can look different depending on the screen. Let me just confirm the return policy for that item.

Okay, I've checked. Since the helmet is a standard item and you received it just 10 days ago, you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can absolutely approve this return for a full refund.

That's good to hear. Now, since I'll be ordering a replacement and paying for shipping again, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next order? I'm still set on a VeloFit helmet for its high safety ratings.

I appreciate you asking, and I'm glad you trust our product's safety. However, our policy doesn't allow for goodwill credits on returns due to color preference. I can assure you the return process is simple, and you'll receive a full refund once we get the unopened box back at our warehouse.
Alright, fair enough. I understand you have policies to follow. Please go ahead and start the return process.
Of course. I am emailing you the return instructions and a prepaid shipping label right now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, David.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and ride safely.
